workflow.label: Delivery context
workflow.description: How learners progress through the design (pedagogic delivery mode).

workflow.label: Design scope
workflow.description: Breadth of the learning design (single activity through module).

workflow.label: Input strategy
workflow.description: Whether the workflow generates from a topic, uses uploaded material, or both.

workflow.label: Session duration (minutes)
workflow.description: Total session duration used for sequencing and workflow constraints.

step.label: Page profile
step.description: Who the assembled page is primarily for.

step.label: Question strategy
step.description: Assessment type for the blueprint (maps from brief assessment type).

step.label: Number of items
step.description: How many assessment items to generate (inherits Design Assessment total_items by default).

step.label: Allowed response formats
step.description: Permitted item response formats (inherits from Design Assessment activity_type by default).

step.label: Difficulty profile
step.description: Item-set difficulty emphasis (inherits from Design Assessment by default).

step.label: Coverage mode
step.description: Outcome/theme coverage for generated items (inherits from Design Assessment coverage_scope by default).

step.label: Composition mode
step.description: Whether the item set uses a single format or a mixed set.

step.label: Stimulus mode
step.description: Whether items are direct questions or anchored to scenarios/problems/cases.

step.label: Stimulus scope
step.description: Shared vs per-item stimulus when using scenario/problem/case-based items.

step.label: Cognitive emphasis
step.description: Dominant cognitive level emphasis across generated items.

step.label: Item feedback mode
step.description: Learner-facing feedback included with generated items (distinct from Design Feedback step).

step.label: Response mode mix
step.description: Preferred mix of selected vs constructed response modes.

step.label: Include examples
step.description: Whether the page should include illustrative examples.

step.label: Total assessment items
step.description: Total items/questions in the assessment blueprint.

step.label: Coverage scope
step.description: How broadly the assessment blueprint should cover outcomes/themes.

step.label: Difficulty profile
step.description: Overall difficulty distribution for the assessment blueprint (maps from brief difficulty_profile).

step.label: Cognitive demand profile
step.description: Dominant thinking level targeted by assessment tasks.

step.label: Assessment cadence
step.description: How assessment is distributed across the broader learning scope.

step.label: Feedback display
step.description: How answers/feedback are planned in the blueprint (prompt-shaping; distinct from Design Feedback step).

step.label: Structure mode
step.description: How normalized source content is structured.

step.label: Detail level
step.description: How much detail to preserve when normalizing content.

step.label: Keep examples
step.description: Whether to retain meaningful examples from the source.

step.label: Include concept relationships
step.description: Include explicit relationships between concepts in the knowledge model.

step.label: Include misconceptions
step.description: Include likely misconceptions when supported by the source.

step.label: Include processes/workflows
step.description: Include processes or workflows when present in the source.

step.label: Learner level
step.description: Target learner level for outcome wording (maps from brief learner level).

step.label: Number of outcomes
step.description: How many learning outcomes to generate.

step.label: Cognitive emphasis
step.description: Cognitive emphasis across generated outcomes.

step.label: Outcome scope
step.description: Scope framing for generated outcomes.

step.label: Activity pattern mix
step.description: Balance of guided vs applied/collaborative activity patterns.

step.label: Grouping preference
step.description: Preferred learner grouping modes across activities.

step.label: Activity difficulty
step.description: Challenge level for designed learning activities.

step.label: Coverage breadth
step.description: How broadly activities should cover outcomes.

step.label: Session materials
step.description: Which session-level material types to generate.

step.label: Sequence duration (minutes)
step.description: Total duration for the constructed learning sequence.

step.label: Sequencing granularity
step.description: How detailed the learning sequence plan should be.

step.label: Sequencing style
step.description: Pedagogic sequencing style for the session plan.
